Maslow five needs retain physiological eating/drinking/sleep, safety, belonging/love, recognition and self-realization. Source grouping of basic versus social needs preserved; belonging is not identical to recognition; model is neither mandatory step-completion procedure nor ranking of human worth.
Food assistance/safety and social contact/choice wishes are both retained; physical support need does not remove social needs or authorize worker-chosen friends.

Vital-sign information includes temperature/respiration/pulse/BP with complaint and baseline differences, not single-value whole-body judgment; observed changes are communicated to necessary recipient.

Airway retains nasal cavity/pharynx/larynx/trachea/bronchi and alveolus-surrounding-blood gas exchange, oxygen into blood and carbon dioxide from blood via lungs out. Respiration varies with age/activity/feeling/health/disease and is observed beyond count, including distress, sound/sputum/baseline.

Cyanosis is qualified important blue-purple lip/nail change possibly related to oxygen lack; no color change is not safety. Cough/sputum expels foreign material; persistent cough or sputum color change is reportable but not diagnosis of pathogen/disease from observation alone.

Pulse retains transmission of heart beat to arteries, count/rhythm/strength and actual measured/observed information with time/site/method/state. Radial/brachial/superficial temporal/carotid plus groin/dorsal foot sites retained; recognizing sites is not permission for independent neck manipulation.
